headline_cards.label: Factories — Environmental Clearance (EC)
headline_cards.subtitle: Metallurgy, cement, chemicals, refineries, distilleries & bulk drugs (IND1/IND2/IND3 · P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: Statutory post-EIA EC benchmark: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC + 45d authority). P2 completed durations restricted to filings 2022–mid-2024 to prevent right-censoring.

headline_cards.label: Factories — Appraised Terms of Reference (ToR)
headline_cards.subtitle: Bespoke EAC/SEAC scoping before EIA study & public hearing (P1 wall-clock + P2 full-stage filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 60 days (EIA Notification 2006 Para 7(i) Stage 2 Scoping)

headline_cards.note: Statutory Scoping benchmark: 60 days under EIA Notification 2006. Gov/Applicant split over P2 full-stage histories (filings 2022–mid-2024); wall-clock includes P1 milestone histories.

headline_cards.label: Factories — Online Standard / Auto-ToR
headline_cards.subtitle: System/SEIAA Standard ToR eligible sectors under MoEFCC OM 06.05.2022 (filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 7 days MS scrutiny for online Standard ToR (MoEFCC OM 06.05.2022)

headline_cards.note: Statutory MS scrutiny window for Standard ToR: 7 days (P2 filings 2022–mid-2024).

headline_cards.label: Major Mines (Coal & Non-Coal) — Environmental Clearance
headline_cards.subtitle: Substantive industrial mines excluding 0–5 ha Form-2 minor quarries (P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: Separates major industrial coal & mineral leases from 0–5 ha minor quarry permits (unweighted within strata; P2 filings 2022–mid-2024).

headline_cards.label: Coal Mines (CMIN) — Environmental Clearance
headline_cards.subtitle: Central MoEFCC & State SEIAA coal mining & washery clearances (P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: Coal projects frequently encounter cross-clearance Stage-I Forest Clearance interlocks (P2 filings 2022–mid-2024).

headline_cards.label: Major Non-Coal Mines — Environmental Clearance
headline_cards.subtitle: Limestone, iron ore, bauxite & >5 ha / cluster mineral leases (P1 2014–22 + P2 sampled filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: Substantive non-coal mineral leases (P1 N=364 full-stage + 174 SEIAA milestone; P2 N=300 sampled of 6,560 non-Form-2 MIN rows, unweighted).

headline_cards.label: Minor Mineral Quarries (0–5 ha Form-2) — EC
headline_cards.subtitle: Small sand, gravel, murrum & rough stone B2 quarry permits at State SEIAAs (40,145 P2 directory filings)
headline_cards.suppression_reason: Suppressed: PARIVESH 2.0 Form-2 minor-mineral sample has <30 stage-history grants (51 non-granted of 40,145 extracted before WAF cutoff; P1 search_b.aspx is milestone-only).

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: Duration quantiles suppressed: only 22 Form-2 timelines extracted in P2 (<30 threshold) and P1 SEIAA Form-2 records are milestone-only without desk-level Gov/Applicant stage splits.

headline_cards.label: Power Generation (Thermal & Hydro) — EC
headline_cards.subtitle: Utility & captive thermal power plants (THE) + hydroelectric / pumped storage (RIV · P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: Both Thermal and Hydro are ineligible for online Auto-ToR and require full EAC/SEAC appraisal (P2 filings 2022–mid-2024).

headline_cards.label: Thermal Power Plants (THE) — EC
headline_cards.subtitle: Coal, gas, lignite & biomass power generation (P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: 79% of Thermal & Hydro EC/ToR filings sit at Central MoEFCC (Category A · P1+P2 combined N>=30; P2-only THE cell <30 suppressed separately).

headline_cards.label: Hydropower, Pumped Storage & River Valley (RIV) — EC
headline_cards.subtitle: Hydroelectric generation >=25 MW & river valley projects (P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 105 days (60d EAC/SEAC appraisal + 45d authority decision, EIA Notification 2006 Para 7 & 8)

headline_cards.note: Includes Pumped Storage Projects (PSPs) notified under S.O. 2226(E) (P1+P2 combined N>=30; P2-only RIV cell <30 suppressed separately).

headline_cards.label: Solar, Wind & Transmission Grid — Forest & Wildlife
headline_cards.subtitle: EC-exempt renewable & transmission projects regulated via FC & WLC (P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)
headline_cards.note: Solar PV, wind & transmission lines are exempt from EC under EIA 2006 but enter FC & WLC when crossing forest/ESZ land.

headline_cards.label: Forest Clearance (FC) — Stage-II / Final Diversion
headline_cards.subtitle: End-to-end forest diversion across DFO -> CF -> Nodal -> State -> IRO/FAC + compliance (P1 2014–22 + P2 filings 2022–mid-2024)

statutory_breach.benchmark_label: 150 days cumulative State + Central Stage-I/II regulator processing benchmark

headline_cards.note: Separates multi-tier government scrutiny & intra-gov queries from User Agency Stage-I CAMPA/FRA compliance.

headline_cards.label: Wildlife Clearance (WLC) — Disposed
headline_cards.subtitle: Protected Area & Eco-Sensitive Zone clearances via CWLW -> SBWL -> SC-NBWL (PARIVESH 2.0 filings 2022–mid-2024)
headline_cards.note: 50.3% of all PARIVESH 2.0 WLC filings sit in Pending at Proponent; completed durations restricted to filings 2022–mid-2024.

headline_cards.label: Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) — Granted / Recommended
headline_cards.subtitle: Coastal industrial, desalination, pipeline, port & transmission clearances via SCZMA & MoEFCC (filings 2022–mid-2024)
headline_cards.note: Covers standalone CRZ clearances and SCZMA -> SEIAA/MoEFCC statutory recommendations (PARIVESH 2.0 filings 2022–mid-2024).
